raw_response:
I farm the same 4.1 mu in the old wheat-maize way, so I will not do anything fancy this year. I am old, the land is small, and every bag of input costs real money, but I still do not want to be stingy on fertilizer because if yield drops, that loss is bigger than wasting a little肥料. For wheat, I will use an improved variety because around here the better seed usually stands more evenly and fills better than the old seed. I will give the wheat a solid base fertilizer, then topdress once in spring, and with my well I will water about 3 times if the season is normal. Wheat is the crop I do not want to starve. For maize after wheat, I will sow hybrid seed because that is what people around me mostly use now, and it gives steadier ears. Summer rain helps maize, so I will water less, usually 2 times is enough if rain comes on time. I will keep tillage simple with rotary work to save labor. I will spray each crop about 2 times, not too much, just enough to keep disease, insects, and grass from taking yield. On my small 4.1 mu, I will stay close to what has worked before, with a small push on seed and fertilizer so I can hold yield steady.
